fact: The driver of Car 27 Failed to follow the Race Director's instructions
offence: Breach of Article 33.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, Breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Notes (item 1, document 5).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 27 (Nico Hulkenberg), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, team radio and in-car video evidence. The driver left the pit exit with an appropriate gap to the car in front (PIA) however prior to him joining the track another car (ALO) came down the straight and overtook PIA, causing PIA to slow down, significantly reducing the gap that existed back to Car 27. The driver of Car 27 then noting that there was no car approaching him, slowed to re-create the original gap with PIA. The driver did not impede any other driver, and did not drive in an unsafe manner, hence no penalty is imposed.
rules_referenced: Article 33.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 27 Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions
